verdict_summary: Strong Python/FastAPI backend foundation and genuine production single-agent RAG experience with Chroma and section-based chunking. However, candidate openly has zero production multi-agent orchestration experience (LangGraph/CrewAI), having only built toy projects.

strengths.claim: Demonstrated production RAG pipeline implementation using Chroma and semantic section-based chunking
4-year track record maintaining Python/FastAPI microservices and OCR ingestion pipelines
Hands-on experience migrating document ingestion to OCR extraction

gaps.claim: Lacks production multi-agent orchestration framework experience (LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen)
40% accuracy improvement metric was based on informal spot-checks rather than rigorous benchmark
